math_steps.explanation: $$\begin{gathered}f\!\left(x\right)=\sqrt{ax^{2}+2x- 5 a + 5}\\\text{任意 }x_{2},x_{1}\in \left(-\infty, -2\right],\ x_{2}\ne x_{1}:\ \dfrac{f(x_{2})-f(x_{1})}{x_{2}-x_{1}}<0\\\Rightarrow f\!\left(x\right)\ \text{在}\ \left(-\infty, -2\right]\ \text{上严格递减}\end{gathered}$$
math_steps.title: 读清单调性要求

math_steps.explanation: $$\begin{gathered}f(x)=\sqrt{g(x)}\\g(x)=ax^{2}+2x- 5 a + 5\\\sqrt{u}\ \text{在}\ [0,+\infty)\ \text{上严格递增}\\\Rightarrow g\ \text{在}\ \left(-\infty, -2\right]\ \text{上严格递减，且}\ g(x)\ge 0\end{gathered}$$
math_steps.title: 转化为内层条件

math_steps.explanation:
$$\begin{gathered}a=0\\g\!\left(x\right)=2x+5\\\text{斜率}\ 2>0,\ \text{严格递增}\Rightarrow a=0\ \text{舍去}\end{gathered}$$

$$\begin{gathered}a>0:\ \text{开口向上，对称轴}\ x=- \frac{1}{a}\\\text{严格递减的部分}:\ x\le - \frac{1}{a}\\- \frac{1}{a}\ge -2\Rightarrow a\in \left[\frac{1}{2}, +\infty\right)\end{gathered}$$

$$\begin{gathered}a<0:\ \text{开口向下，对称轴}\ x=- \frac{1}{a}\\\text{严格递减的部分}:\ x\ge - \frac{1}{a}\\\left(-\infty, -2\right]\not\subseteq \left\{x\mid x\ge - \frac{1}{a}\right\}\Rightarrow a<0\ \text{舍去}\end{gathered}$$

$$\begin{gathered}a=0:\ \text{舍去}\\a>0:\ a\in \left[\frac{1}{2}, +\infty\right)\\a<0:\ \text{舍去}\\\text{各类合并}:\ a\in \left[\frac{1}{2}, +\infty\right)\end{gathered}$$

highlight.caption: 内层按二次项系数分类

math_steps.title: 内层按二次项系数分类

math_steps.explanation: $$\begin{gathered}g(x)=ax^{2}+2x- 5 a + 5\\a\in \left[\frac{1}{2}, +\infty\right):\ g\ \text{严格递减}\\\min g=g(-2)=1 - a\\1 - a\ge 0\Rightarrow a\in \left(-\infty, 1\right]\end{gathered}$$
math_steps.title: 整段能开方

math_steps.explanation: $$\begin{gathered}\text{内层严格递减}:\ a\in \left[\frac{1}{2}, +\infty\right)\\\text{整段}\ g(x)\ge 0:\ a\in \left(-\infty, 1\right]\\\text{取交集}:\ a\in \left[\frac{1}{2}, 1\right]\end{gathered}$$

items.label: 已确认条件
items.math: \begin{gathered}\text{内层严格递减}:\ a\in \left[\frac{1}{2}, +\infty\right)\\\text{整段}\ g(x)\ge 0:\ a\in \left(-\infty, 1\right]\end{gathered}
